_about: Synthetic doctor monologues for testing and demos. Every name, date and instruction is invented. 'expected' is what a correct extraction contains; relative times are stated relative to visit_date. Medicine amounts are whatever the doctor said, recorded as said, never suggested by the app.

visits.transcript: Okay, so Meera is four months now and she is growing well, weight is six point four kilos, that is fine. Today we have given the third dose of the pentavalent vaccine and the polio drops. She may get a mild fever tonight, that is normal. If the temperature goes above one hundred, give paracetamol drops, zero point six ml, only if there is fever, not more than four times in a day. Continue the vitamin D drops, one ml every morning, every day, do not stop. Keep her only on breast milk, no water, no gripe water, no honey, nothing else till six months. Give her tummy time when she is awake, at least three or four times a day. Watch the injection site, if there is swelling bigger than a coin or it becomes red and hot, come and show me. The next vaccine is at six months, so come back on the eighth of December. Bring the vaccination card every time.

watch_for: injection site swelling bigger than a coin, red or hot
dos: only breast milk till six months
tummy time three or four times a day when awake
bring the vaccination card every time

visits.title: 4-month check-up

visits.transcript: It is a viral cold, the chest is clear, nothing to worry about. For the blocked nose, put saline nasal drops, two drops in each nostril, three times a day, for five days. Before feeds is best. For the cough, give the syrup I am writing, two point five ml at night only, for three days. Keep feeding her, small and frequent feeds are fine. Do not use any vapour rub on her face. Do not give cough syrups from the medical shop on your own. Watch her breathing. If she is breathing very fast, or the chest is pulling in, or she is not feeding at all, or the fever goes above one hundred and two, bring her immediately, do not wait. Otherwise come for review after three days.

medicines.name: saline nasal drops
medicines.when: three times a day, before feeds

donts: no vapour rub on the face
no cough syrups from the shop on your own

visits.title: Cold and cough

visits.transcript: She has loose motions, but she is not dehydrated, the tongue is wet and she is passing urine. Give ORS after every loose stool, about half a cup, small sips with a spoon. Give zinc syrup, five ml once a day after lunch, for fourteen days, complete the full course even if the motions stop. Continue breastfeeding and her normal food, rice, dal, curd, banana is good. Avoid fruit juices and biscuits for now. Look at the stools, if you see blood in the stool, or she is vomiting everything, or she stops passing urine for six hours, come immediately. Before coming next time, collect a stool sample in the morning in the container from the lab. Come back on Monday.

medicines.name: ORS
medicines.amount: about half a cup, small sips

dos: rice, dal, curd, banana are good
tests: morning stool sample in the lab container before next visit

visits.title: Loose motions

visits.transcript: Your stitches have healed well. Your haemoglobin is a little low, nine point eight, so take the iron tablet once a day after lunch for three months, and the calcium tablet at night after dinner. Do not take iron and calcium together, keep a gap. Drink plenty of water and eat green leafy vegetables, dates and jaggery. Avoid lifting anything heavy for another four weeks. If you have heavy bleeding, fever, or pain in the calf, come immediately. We will repeat the haemoglobin test after six weeks, so come back for a blood test then.

dos: green leafy vegetables, dates and jaggery
donts: do not take iron and calcium together
no heavy lifting for four weeks

visits.title: Mother's postnatal check

visits.transcript: बच्चे को वायरल बुखार है, घबराने की कोई बात नहीं है। बुखार सौ से ऊपर जाए तो पैरासिटामोल सिरप ढाई एमएल दीजिए, दिन में चार बार से ज़्यादा नहीं। गुनगुने पानी से शरीर पोंछिए। दूध पिलाते रहिए। अगर बच्चा बहुत सुस्त हो जाए, या दौरा पड़े, या शरीर पर लाल दाने दिखें, तो तुरंत आइए। दो दिन बाद दिखाने आइए।

medicines.name: paracetamol syrup
medicines.when: if fever above 100, not more than four times a day

visits.title: Viral fever

visits.transcript: இன்று குழந்தைக்கு ஆறு வார தடுப்பூசி போட்டோம். இரவு லேசான காய்ச்சல் வரலாம். காய்ச்சல் இருந்தால் மட்டும் பாராசிட்டமால் சொட்டு மருந்து கொடுங்கள். ஊசி போட்ட இடத்தில் எதுவும் தேய்க்க வேண்டாம். அடுத்த தடுப்பூசி நான்கு வாரம் கழித்து, நவம்பர் ஏழாம் தேதி வாருங்கள்.

donts: do not rub anything on the injection site

visits.title: 6-week vaccines

visits.transcript: బాబు బరువు బాగా పెరుగుతున్నాడు. ఆరు నెలలు నిండాయి కాబట్టి ఇప్పుడు ఘన ఆహారం మొదలుపెట్టవచ్చు. మొదట మెత్తని అన్నం, పప్పు, అరటిపండు గుజ్జు రోజుకు రెండు సార్లు ఇవ్వండి. తేనె, ఉప్పు, చక్కెర ఒక సంవత్సరం వరకు ఇవ్వకండి. ఐరన్ సిరప్ రోజుకు ఒకసారి ఉదయం ఇవ్వండి. ఒక నెల తర్వాత మళ్ళీ రండి.

medicines.name: iron syrup
medicines.when: once a day in the morning

dos: start solids: soft rice, dal, mashed banana twice a day
donts: no honey, salt or sugar until one year

visits.title: Starting solids

visits.transcript: Baby ko halka sa jaundice hai, the yellow colour is only on the face and chest, that is okay for one week old. Feed every two to three hours, even at night, wake her up for feeds. Keep her in morning sunlight is not needed, that is an old belief, don't do that. Check the colour of the poop. If the potty becomes pale or white like chalk, or the urine is dark yellow, come the same day. We will do a bilirubin test the day after tomorrow, come at nine in the morning.

watch_for: yellow colour spreading beyond face and chest
dos: feed every two to three hours, wake her at night for feeds
check the colour of the poop
donts: do not put her in sunlight for jaundice
tests: bilirubin test the day after tomorrow at 9 am

visits.title: Newborn jaundice

visits.transcript: Baby has fever, take paracetamol 5 ml after each meal. If it doesn't decrease, take him to me after 3 days.

appointments.what: review if fever does not decrease

visits.title: Fever (real recording)
